# ReferencingObjects

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Confusing constructs](/rules/#confusing-constructs) · PhpStorm name: `ReferencingObjectsInspection`

Since PHP 5, object handles are passed and assigned by value of the handle:
the callee already works on the same object. Taking objects by reference
(`Foo &$x` parameters, `$x = &new Foo()`) is a PHP 4 leftover that only
confuses readers — unless the reference is really used to replace the
caller's variable.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{2,3,6,7,11} [Before]
<?php
$cache = & new ArrayObject([]);
$queue =&new SplQueue;
$plain = new SplStack();

function attach(DOMNode &$node, array &$list, &$any, int &$n) {}
function detach(?DOMNode& $node, ?string &$label, iterable &$it) {}

interface Visitor {
    public function visit(
        Tree & $tree,
        mixed &$extra
    );
}

function replace(DOMNode &$node) {
    $node = new DOMText('x');
}
function check(DOMNode &$a, DOMNode &$b, DOMNode &$c, DOMNode &$d = null) {
    if (($a)) {}
    return !$b || ($c ? 1 : 0);
}
$fn = function (DOMNode &$node) {};
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
$cache = new ArrayObject([]);
$queue = new SplQueue;
$plain = new SplStack();

function attach(DOMNode $node, array &$list, &$any, int &$n) {}
function detach(?DOMNode $node, ?string &$label, iterable &$it) {}

interface Visitor {
    public function visit(
        Tree $tree,
        mixed &$extra
    );
}

function replace(DOMNode &$node) {
    $node = new DOMText('x');
}
function check(DOMNode &$a, DOMNode &$b, DOMNode &$c, DOMNode &$d = null) {
    if (($a)) {}
    return !$b || ($c ? 1 : 0);
}
$fn = function (DOMNode &$node) {};
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Objects are handed over by handle already; assign the new instance without &#39;&amp;&#39;.</li>
<li>line 3: Objects are handed over by handle already; assign the new instance without &#39;&amp;&#39;.</li>
<li>line 6: Objects are handed over by handle already; drop the &#39;&amp;&#39; before &#39;$node&#39;.</li>
<li>line 7: Objects are handed over by handle already; drop the &#39;&amp;&#39; before &#39;$node&#39;.</li>
<li>line 11: Objects are handed over by handle already; drop the &#39;&amp;&#39; before &#39;$tree&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ReferencingObjects": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore ReferencingObjects

/**
 * @noinspection ReferencingObjectsInspection
 */
```
